for someone who talks a lot about masking and the importance of clean air, you'd think using a tool that runs on data centres that poisons the air of the local communities would be a big no-no

The only thing “agonizingly unserious” is anyone using Elon Musk’s AI platform day in and day out trying to claim they have the moral high ground on a high profile journalist known for reporting critically on AI, who occasionally uses the tools *it’s her job to report on.*




ᴘᴏᴛᴀᴛᴜᴍ (@pot8um)

the "blah blah blah" being the pollution of Black neighborhoods, exploitation of the global South, neurocognitive effects, creative theft, replacement of human interaction, superheating, climate collapse

Jake (@RealRockatansky)

good work, everyone

Yeah I also spend hours facetiming friends and family members since my siblings and nephews are in another state. Idk what to say!
I like tech journalism, thanks! And as someone who worked for 9 years in retail, I can promise you "offline" jobs are not "healthier."

Yeah quote tweeting a line from an article with very explicit quote marks and a link to the article is poor communication, it certainly has nothing to do with bad actors who don't like me willfully misrepresenting my point!

Most of my screentime is not "online." I edit my videos, sometimes for 9-10 hours at a time, I edit my podcast, I write and report stories, I do a ton of work in Canva. There's a lot to do on a laptop! The music I play to go to sleep also counts as screentime btw since it's playing off my phone :)
My phone screen time is only a couple hours per day max, I'm on my laptop all day working!! Idk what to tell you guys, I work 7 days a week. If you want to throw stones then u gotta pay my bills!
People do you can do things on your laptop other than go on social media right....? I spend 9-10 hours just in Premiere regularly
You know you can do things on your laptop other than go on social media right....? I spend 9-10 hours just in Premiere regularly
I'm featured in WIRED again this week, (this time in their print issue!!) Had such a great time chatting with them about AI agents, inbox infinity, how I use my phone
The video literally talks about that! Did you watch?

Very eager to hear people’s thoughts on this video. I think he explains the issues with the left’s current rhetoric surrounding AI very well.

anyone ever noticed how psychotically evil, cruel, and anti-human republicans are
